title: Holes don't line up properly
text: Holes don't line up properly. These are basically the same quality I would expect from a dollar store. None of the predrilled holes on the two shelves actually lined up correctly with brackets. One side lines up and the other is off by a full inch. I ended up having to predrill new holes and frankly, if I'm going to that much trouble, then I'll just buy real wood and do it right. They look ok and are best suited for just light photos or maybe spices in the kitchen - definitely not strong enough to hold cups or bottles of shampoo etc. I won't buy another set of these shelves - I'll just make my own.

product_metadata.title: Magicfly Wall Mounted Floating Shelves Set of 2, Wood Shelves for Bedroom Living Room Bathroom Kitchen Home Décor Storage, Easy Assembly, White
features: Sturdy & Harmless Material: Magicfly Floating Shelves are Made of P2 particle board which is harmless. Thick (0. 63”) and strong enough to storage stuff like books, magazines, plants, photo frame, candles, wine, mug, ashtray and so on.

Multifunctional Shelves : Wall shelves can be your storage shelves or decorating shelves in your bathroom, living room, bedroom, office, kitchen, balcony, etc. They adopts modern style and neutral color design, which can be suitable for most home styles.

Upgraded Design: Wood shelves offer thick and widened metal brackets to increase the stability and load-bearing of the product. Also, the metal brackets offer holes so that you can tie a rope through the brackets as a hanger to your shelves.
Easy Assembly: 2 boards, 4 metal brackets, 8 long & 8 short screws and 8 drywall anchors are included. Extremely easy to install following the instruction.
Large Loading Bear: The load-bearing capacity of the wall mounted shelves is 50 lbs, each wood shelf 25 lbs. They work better on Solid walls than on other walls.
